idps.name: Acme IdP
idps.note: The 'real' IdP: registration issues a verification code (returned in the register response, simulating email delivery) and authorize refuses unverified identities. This is the control IdP.

idps.name: QuickIdP
idps.note: PLANTED (row #489): this IdP never verifies email at all — any email registers and is immediately usable as an OAuth identity, and the relying party trusts its email claim anyway.

users.note: Documented lab login (fake fixture, same convention as coupon-lab). Pre-registered at both IdPs: verified at idp-acme, unverified-but-usable at idp-quick.
